purpose: 添付参考の細いラフなペン線、低彩度のフラットな塗りで整備士を作成。セピア調と紙の質感を除去したタッチ確認用。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Create ONE original campervan mechanic character illustration closely matching the DRAWING TECHNIQUE of the supplied reference. The reference is the visual style anchor; its fine irregular pen line, restrained color and unpolished human comic drawing are much more important than a conventional polished anime look.

Subject: an approachable Japanese male mechanic around 38, ordinary sturdy build, slightly broad cheeks, rounded nose, thick natural brows, short practical dark hair swept to one side, clean-shaven. Calm, small closed-mouth smile. Simple muted charcoal-blue work coveralls with two chest pockets and rolled sleeves over a plain pale-gray undershirt. One natural hand holds a small plain steel open-ended wrench around waist/chest height, the other relaxed. No gloves, no glasses.

Framing: a single waist-up portrait, 4:5 canvas, three-quarter side view facing LEFT, head turned about 60 degrees toward the left like the reference's natural profile. Entire head, elbows and hands inside the frame. A very simple flat light neutral gray background matching the reference. No workshop, no computer, no panel, no alternate expressions or design sheet.

MATCH THE REFERENCE'S ACTUAL GRAPHIC CONSTRUCTION:
- Thin slightly scratchy BLACK pen contour, with small natural variations and occasional overshoot strokes, rather than thick smooth outer outlines.
- Face drawn with a few economical slightly angular lines: small normal eye, a modest nose bridge, sparse cheek and smile-crease marks. No giant glossy eyes, no highlighted model face.
- Hair defined by a simple irregular silhouette and a small number of quick directional strokes, filled with flat dark gray. One flat dull-gray shadow shape maximum. No complex flowing strands and absolutely no shiny white hair highlights.
- Clothes filled with one flat desaturated blue-gray color plus ONE muted purple-gray flat shadow tone, with a few clearly drawn crease lines. NO mottled texture, photoreal shading, soft gradients, shiny materials or dense microfolds.
- Skin is flat LOW-SATURATION beige-pink, close to the reference's subtle skin color, with one small flat shadow; NOT glowing orange, tan, yellow or peach gradients.
- Sparse short parallel hatch strokes at neck and cuffs only, just as in the reference. NOT full-surface sketch fuzz, paper grain or canvas texture.
- Overall handmade commercial manga drawing with matter-of-fact human character acting. The smooth fill and sketchy thin contour should coexist, exactly as in reference.

No sepia color cast, no parchment tint, no aged-paper or watercolor texture, no airbrush, no realistic rendered light, no 3D, no heavy glossy anime cel shading, no stock-cartoon face. Do not copy the reference's elderly gray-haired man, glasses, purple collared shirt, monitor or displayed manga. Do not include any text, labels, symbols, speech bubbles, logos, border or watermark.
